name: Tempe
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Tempe for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (World of Illumination: Reindeer Road) through January 3, with the Fantasy of Lights Street Parade and Tree Lighting on Mill Avenue (November 28), Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas The Musical at ASU Gammage (December 1 to 6), Christmas at the Petersen House Museum (from December 5) and the Santa Paddle and Fantasy of Lights Boat Parade at Tempe Town Lake (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Tempe

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Tempe
  • 6 free events, including Christmas at the Petersen House Museum, Santa Paddle and the Fantasy of Lights Street Parade
  • Meet Santa: Fantasy of Lights Street Parade and Tree Lighting (November 28), Fantasy of Lights Boat Parade (December 12) and Sensory Santa at Bierman Autism Centers Tempe (December 19)
  • Parades and lights: Fantasy of Lights Street Parade (November 28), Fantasy of Lights Boat Parade (December 12) and World of Illumination: Reindeer Road
  • Also new: Christmas at the Petersen House Museum, Santa Paddle and the Grinch musical at ASU Gammage
  • Season: November 13 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Tempe families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Phoenix, which covers ZooLights, Las Noches de las Luminarias and the APS Electric Light Parade.
